name: rozgarmitra
description: RozgarMitra - Local Jobs & Daily-Wage Worker Platform. Convenience wrapper so npm commands work from the repository root.
//: This file holds NO dependencies of its own. `admin` and `backend` are ordinary, independent npm projects; these scripts just delegate to them via --prefix. npm workspaces were deliberately avoided: they hoist into a root node_modules and would silently move every existing dependency, which is a large, disruptive change to make while working. `npm install` in a subfolder must keep working exactly as before.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix admin install
